title: LIN Pack
text: Pack signals into data frame by using configuration in LIN description file, 1 input, 1 output, {Select Frame} sets LIN frame; {LDF File Name} sets the file path and {Frame ID} sets the lIN frame ID. Values come from the instance.

params.name: LDF File Name
params.values: File path of LDF empty (default) | character vector | string scalar

params.name: Select Frame
params.values: LIN frame None (default) | character vector | string scalar
